title: Expedited: Patch ION DAO Accounting and Quarantine Legacy Claims
summary: Atomically migrate the adminless ION DAO contract to reviewed v0.0.2 before proposals 22-39 can enter their ordinary legacy-deposit claim path. The patch fixes future proposal-deposit accounting and blocks unsafe pre-migration claims. It does not distribute funds, move the DAO treasury, assign an admin, or alter the ION staking contract.
details:
The live ION DAO contract at osmo1k8re7jwz6rnnwrktnejdwkwnncte7ek7gt29gvnl3sdrg9mtnqkse6nmqm reports code ID 3, no admin, and CW2 crates.io:ion-dao 0.0.1. An ordinary ION DAO WasmMsg::Migrate cannot pass wasmd authorization because the contract has no stored admin. The required route is Osmosis x/gov executing /cosmwasm.wasm.v1.MsgStoreAndMigrateContract under governance authority osmo10d07y265gmmuvt4z0w9aw880jnsr700jjeq4qp.

At the 2026-07-11 19:27:02 UTC snapshot, proposals 22-39 were all open and unclaimable. They recorded 662 ION of deposits although normal retained base across 18 proposals was 9 ION, creating apparent excess claim exposure of 653 ION. Their voting windows end from 2026-07-17 11:09:01 through 11:30:35 UTC. Ordinary rejection or failed quorum can be closed into a refundable state; only a successful veto path confiscates.

The v0.0.2 migration requires exact CW2 source and version, records an inclusive migration cutoff, blocks pre-cutoff claims before mutation or bank send, rejects fresh same-block proposal and top-up traps, and fixes net retained accounting for future proposals. It does not pay claims, distribute ION or OSMO, move the DAO treasury, assign an admin, or alter the ION staking contract.

The production artifact is 447,489 bytes with SHA-256 37bb98453ddf9495c2cdf9a2667d515164ef9e09b15385921eaba9270d148f3e. Validation passed 80 DAO tests, 8 stake tests, Rust 1.64 formatting and strict Clippy, schema and TypeScript regeneration and build, repeated byte-identical Wasm builds, optimizer reproducibility, and independent exact-head review.

A bounded Juno mainnet proof migrated a self-admin proof DAO from code 5142 to 5143, set cutoff height 39710117, rejected a simulated legacy claim with 'Deposit claim requires manual reconciliation', and preserved a normal post-migration one-time claim. This proves migration and state behavior; the native Osmosis governance route is separately established by the exact authority and same-message precedents in Osmosis proposals 853 and 896.

Expedited governance is recommended because the standard five-day voting window can no longer finish safely before the first claim window. The expedited vote lasts 24 hours. A 5,000 OSMO initial deposit creates the proposal in deposit period; voting starts only after cumulative deposits reach 20,000 OSMO.

Full rationale, exact payload, limits, vote guidance, source links, and proof receipts: ipfs://bafkreibjw2ogu477jn2vgqsivojsr72ipdhmr23lgdo52zrehb7oixm57m
vote_option_context: YES: execute the reviewed atomic in-place patch and quarantine legacy claims. NO: leave the contract unchanged while seeking another implementation; this does not itself contain the approaching claim path. NO WITH VETO: reserve for abuse/spam; current Osmosis parameters burn deposits on a final veto outcome. ABSTAIN: count toward quorum without choosing Yes or No.
